messages:
alice: Heads-up — I have a chain of PRs that need to land together: SDK -> API -> console (helm) bump. Can we pick a merge slot? Details below. /cc @ben @dan

alice: PRs:
- SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1347
- API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/2589
- Console: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/901
- Helm chart: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/76

ben: Quick check — API change is a small param rename (request.metadata -> request.meta). Does SDK already handle both keys? If not we need a short feature flag.

carla: I opened an SDK follow-up that adds backwards-compat: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1350 — it's dependent on API PR though.

dan: Runtime note: the API pr touches request validation that affects runtime's strict-mode; if we merge we should set runtime strict-mode off for the canary. Suggest merge order: API, SDK, runtime config, then console/helm.

erin: Merge window today is 11:30-12:30 PT (release cadence). I can coordinate merges during that slot. Is that enough time?

alice: Yes. We'll do canary in stack2 then promote. Need approvals: @ben (api), @dan (runtime), @carla (sdk).

ben: Putting api review now. Left a nit about test coverage. Small patch incoming.

deploy-bot: CI status: api PR #2589 — checks/pipeline: failing (flake: percy snapshot).

ben: Percy flake fixed, tests green now. Ready to approve.

carla: SDK PR merged a small fix to accept both keys; I'll hold merge until API is merged and I get green CI.

dan: I'll patch runtime config for canary: add `STRICT_MODE=false` in canary config. Command:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/runtime STRICT_MODE=false --record
```
Will revert after verification.

erin: Good. Plan: 11:30 merge API, wait 2 mins for CI + canary, 11:35 merge SDK, 11:40 push helm bump and console release. I'll be online and do the merges if everyone approves.

alice: All approvals obtained. @ben approved api, @carla pending until sdk green. @dan ok for runtime. Please reaction with :thumbsup: if you want me to go ahead at 11:30.

ben: :thumbsup:

carla: :thumbsup:

dan: :thumbsup:

erin: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy notes: temporary rollout: 5% traffic to canary for 10 minutes then 100% if no errors.

alice: Thanks. I'll post a short post-merge note in #eng-release after promotion.
